content:
maria: Heads-up — aiming for Wed Jun 9 2026, 10:00am PT for the announcement + full rollout. We need one canonical changelog link, docs anchor, and the exact rollout cadence by EOD. Also webinar assets and lead-tagging.

rachel: We can do progressive rollout: canary EU at 09:30 PT (5%), 50% at 09:50, 100% by 10:00 if metrics stable. Ops will pause on p95 > 2x baseline or error-rate >0.8%.

tom: Docs PR is open: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/820 — includes migration notes. Waiting on the two-line perf blurb from eng for the hero and changelog.

maria: Marketing wants a single-sentence headline + one supporting stat for the changelog and social. Keep it punchy.

tom: Draft: "New batching + cache warmup reduces median gen latency by ~21% and lowers per-1k token cost by ~19%." Ill paste exact numbers from the benchmark job by 6pm.

ops-bot: Release window scheduled: 2026-06-09T16:30:00Z -> 2026-06-09T17:10:00Z (canary -> ramp). Runbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-06-09. Monitor channel: #release-watch.

maria: Webinar booked Tue 11:00am PT with product + eng. Need a 90s perf clip + one-slide summary for the email. Who records?

tom: I can record a short terminal demo and upload to the shared drive by tomorrow AM. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media.

salesops: CRM tag: "jun_release_2026". SLA: 48h for lead follow-up. Please add hidden field on webinar and site forms and ensure webhook posts the tag.

rachel: Example webhook payload (simple):

```
{ "email": "lead@example.com", "tags": ["jun_release_2026"] }
```
Will test in staging tonight.

maria: Changelog owner? Need a permalink we can point to in the blog post. Also confirm publish cadence: post 10:00am, social 10:05, email 10:15 PT. Marketing will gate send on ops green.

tom: Changelog PR created: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/201 — Ill add the perf sentence once benchmarks are final and ping for legal review.

ops-bot: Canary started (EU). Logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/123987.

maria: Please ping here when changelog is merged + docs anchor published and when salesops confirms webhook test. Marketing will not publish until ops posts green at 10:00am PT.

ops-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic. Post-deploy checks OK.

maria: Received. Publishing now — scheduled social and email queued. Thanks team!
